checks.name: minkowski_sum_convexity
checks.claim: If C and D are convex, then C + D is convex.
checks.certificate: For z_i = x_i + y_i, the convex average is ((1-t)x_1 + t x_2) + ((1-t)y_1 + t y_2).

checks.name: scalar_multiplication_convexity
checks.claim: If C is convex and alpha is real, alpha C is convex.
checks.certificate: alpha((1-t)x + t y) = (1-t)alpha x + t alpha y.

checks.name: affine_image_preimage_convexity
checks.claim: Affine images and inverse images of convex sets are convex.
checks.certificate: Affine maps commute with convex averages.

checks.name: support_function_identity
checks.claim: h_{A+B}(u) = h_A(u) + h_B(u) for toy polygons and sampled directions.

checks.name: hull_image_equality
checks.claim: A(conv(P)) = conv(A(P)) on the finite point set in hull-commutation-check.json.

checks.name: dimension_rank_bookkeeping
checks.claim: dim(A C) <= min(rank(A), dim(C)); products add dimensions.

checks.name: closure_warning
checks.claim: A linear image of a closed convex set need not be closed.
checks.example: Projection of epi(exp) onto the y-axis gives the open ray y > 0.
